scripts.build:chromium: cross-env NODE_ENV=development TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build --outDir dist/chromium
scripts.build:firefox: cross-env NODE_ENV=development TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build --outDir dist/firefox
scripts.build: pnpm run build:chromium && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.package:chromium: pnpm run build:chromium && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename hello-world-chromium.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename hello-world-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package: pnpm run package:chromium && pnpm run package:firefox
